title: Multilayer anisotropic transfer matrix
description: Python package and Streamlit app computing the optical reflection of multilayer anisotropic stacks with the generalized 4×4 transfer-matrix formalism of Passler & Paarmann (2017). Provides dispersion and isofrequency maps of Im(rpp), polariton mode traces (poles of rpp), and vertical-dipole surface-wave maps, with built-in and custom isotropic/anisotropic materials.
